channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: St. Lucie County school employee arrested for lewd acts in front of two girls
item.description: A St. Lucie County public school employee faces charges for lewd and lascivious behavior in front of two children.

item.title: West Palm Beach company launches hurricane evacuation flight service for $1,250 membership
item.description: A West Palm Beach company is offering Floridians a guaranteed seat on chartered flights out of the state when a hurricane threatens for a $1,250 annual membership fee.

item.title: West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System hosts resource fair at Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Loxahatchee
item.description: The West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System hosted a resource fair for veterans on Friday at Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Loxahatchee to connect veterans with healthcare enrollment and claims support.

item.title: Epstein survivor shares story in WPTV documentary airing July 23
item.description: A local survivor of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse is sharing her story as WPTV reflects on 20 years since the story first broke.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program offers summer service projects for South Florida families
item.description: The TLC Program at B'nai Torah Congregation in Boca Raton is connecting families with hands-on service projects this summer.

item.title: Treasure Coast Traffic Report: Major I-95 Ramp Closures Planned July 19-24
item.description:

item.title: Fort Lauderdale woman arrested in Stuart liquor store credit card theft case
item.description: A Fort Lauderdale woman faces charges connected to stolen credit cards used at a Stuart liquor store.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September citing low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Messi bathed Spain star Lamine Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot before World Cup final matchup
item.description: Photos from a 2007 UNICEF charity calendar show teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal, who now faces Argentina in Sunday's World Cup final for Spain at age 19.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late goals to advance to World Cup final against Spain
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey with President Trump attending
item.description: Federal agents and local law enforcement will implement the highest level of security for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain in New Jersey, with President Trump attending the trophy presentation.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI decision-making
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to make in-game decisions.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics after national top 15 finish
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free program through August 10
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo extended its Kids Free promotion through August 10, allowing up to four children ages 3 to 12 to receive free admission with one adult ticket.

item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa discounts
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August with free fitness classes and wellness offers.

item.title: Boca Raton synagogue offers summer volunteer program for South Florida families
item.description: The TLC Program at B'nai Torah Congregation offers hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Delray Beach dance studio hosts Bridgerton masquerade gala July 24 for ninth anniversary
item.description: Fred Astaire Dance Studios Delray Beach is celebrating nine years with a Bridgerton-style masquerade gala featuring themed decor and dancing.

item.title: Florida fentanyl summit draws teens, grieving parents and DEA chief as overdose crisis takes center stage in Orlando
item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and federal law enforcement at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week, united by a shared mission to stop fentanyl before it kills more Americans. item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs low-altitude Blue Angels flyover in Pensacola as Navy halts safety review
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth voiced support for a fighter jet that flew so low over a Pensacola beach Wednesday that chairs and tents went flying, sand kicked up and children held their hands over their ears.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition is underway at Murray Middle School in Martin County, starting a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage from Hurricane Milton.
